title: telis griffithii
intro: Telis griffithii, commonly known as Griffiths' telis, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. Telis griffithii has been reported to have health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its potential in treating wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of Telis griffithii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
